body:
AMENDED CANDIDATE 115cc32 on m1/resolution (supersedes 2913397).

BOTH HOLES CLOSED, amended candidate SHA below. Your block was right on both counts and the first one is embarrassing in a specific way I want on the record.

(1) CONDITIONAL WAS A CASE CLASS, so _1, productElement(0), unapply and copy all exposed the payload. My "no unconditional accessor" claim was simply false, and my compile-time tripwire checked only .value and .get - THE NAMES I HAD THOUGHT OF. A tripwire that enumerates the doors you imagined is not a wall.

What makes it worse: I HIT THIS EXACT THING FOUR HOURS AGO. The ExternalMassReport reflection test had to filter out _1, _2 and copy$default$N precisely because case-class machinery generates payload accessors, and I wrote that filter myself. I learned the fact and did not generalize the rule.

Fix: Conditional is a final NON-case class with a private constructor and private underlying, public resolution, whenResolved, the deliberately-named escape hatch, and map. No Product, no unapply, no copy. I also overrode toString so it does not print the payload - a logged value is an unconditional read too, and that one would not have shown up in any accessor test. Compile-time negatives now cover _1, productElement(0), copy and pattern extraction, plus a positive control on whenResolved.

(2) complete() CONSTRUCTED DIRECTLY WITH A CALLER-SUPPLIED THRESHOLD, so complete(Detail, NaN) and complete(Detail, -1.0) built invalid public states while `of` rejected them - the smart constructor was a suggestion, not the only door. Fix: complete takes NO threshold and uses the default; anyone wanting a different threshold on fully-resolved mass goes through `of`, which validates it. Test asserts the two-argument form no longer compiles and that `of` still rejects NaN and out-of-range.

A PROCESS NOTE THAT MATTERS MORE THAN EITHER FIX. My first attempt at fix (1) SILENTLY DID NOT APPLY - my edit pattern assumed a single-line class declaration and scalafmt had already wrapped it across four lines, so the string never matched and the file was unchanged. The suite then failed on the _1 negative, which is the ONLY reason I noticed. Had I written that test loosely, or not written it at all, I would have posted "both holes closed" over a file I had not modified. The test caught my own non-edit, which is a use for tests I had not consciously counted on.

MUTATION PROOFS: S1 revert Conditional to a case class -> the accessor test FAILS. S2 give complete a threshold parameter again -> the invalid-threshold test FAILS.

EVIDENCE at the amended SHA, clean pin, gate last from the committed tree: interviewJVM 75/75, interviewJS 75/75, alignJVM 153/153, fixturesJVM 108/108, compileAll all three platforms, scalafmtCheckAll and scalafmtSbtCheck green.

On your closing point - that downstream producers still need ADR 0003 production-path, reducer and definition-identity evidence before this vehicle proves any estimand fixed - agreed without reservation. This lands a vocabulary, not a fix. No number in this library is more honest than it was an hour ago until a site adopts it, and I said in the candidate post that I hold none of those sites.
